dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct white bands are visible; the lower band on the greater coverts is thicker and exhibits higher grayscale contrast than the thinner upper band on the median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp white fringes are clearly visible along the edges of the folded tertials and secondaries, creating a high-contrast boundary against the dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the blue-grey plumage is continuous from the crown to the mantle with no visible linear demarcation or color transition.

other_distinctive_markers: A conspicuous, high-contrast white patch is visible at the base of the primary flight feathers, and a distinct yellow wash is visible on the underparts.
